Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  January 17, 2024

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on January 18, 2024.
Commissioner Metcalf called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. followed by the flag salute.

Stephanie Maldonado announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present: Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1, Commissioner Olivia Alvitre –
  District 2, Commissioner Phyllis Battle ‐ District 3, Commissioner Jacques Lesure -
  Commissioner at Large.

  Absent: Commissioner Vicki Perryman-Banks - District 4,

City Personnel present were as follows:

  Thomas Uwal  Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Director
  Helen Lessick  Public Art Consultant
  Stephanie Maldonado  Senior Management Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

SPECIAL PRESENTATION. Helen Lessick gave a refresher training on the Percent for Art
Ordinance.

MINUTES. None.

STAFF REPORTS. Intuit Dome Public Art Plan. It is recommended that the Arts
Commission provide conditional approval of the Intuit Dome Public Art Plan, submitted
by Berson Studio LLC, to proceed with the continued development of art siting, lighting,
general public access, refined designs and names of nominating curators and galleries and
return to the Commission with a more detailed plan for full recommendation prior to
production. It should be noted, during the presentation, the developer indicated that they
have an updated digital plan, which was not submitted to the Department.

It was moved by Commissioner Lesure and seconded by Commissioner Alvitre that the
Arts Commission hereby approves the recommendation. The motion was carried by the
following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioner Lesure, Olvitre, Battle, and Metcalf
Noes: None

  1
   Arts Commission

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects. Helen Lessick gave a refresher training on
the following:
  1. The Creative House Utility Box program design update: Scope of work includes
  utility box wraps of four (4) boxes in each District. Project is in phase two: design
  development submitted on December 15. There are four artists: Rasta Asaru El,
  Patrick Henry, Mike Norice, and Sam Pace who have four (4) themes.
  2. Senior Center Public Art Incident: The Public Art piece titled Roots by Pontus
  Willfors installed at the Inglewood Senior Center fell and was removed for repair
  on December 14, 2023.

PUBLIC REMARKS. An artist tasked with installing a 60 x 60 mural at Faithful Central
Bible Church on Florence and Eucalyptus Avenues was seeking assistance on do’s and
don’ts.

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. Ethics Refresher Training Spring 2024
  b. Next Art Commission Meeting: February 21, 2024

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Metcalf declared the
meeting adjourned, at 7:50 p.m.
